info.title: Pronunciation Assessment API
info.description: Backend API for automated pronunciation assessments.

requestBody.description: Import one passage from its six version-matched CSV exports, with optional learner-facing context. Files use the field names shown in PassageImportRequest.

413.description: CSV field or request exceeds the bounded import limit

410.description: Link disabled, expired, or requires an unsupported reading count

requestBody.description: Learner metadata, current consent, and one recording containing all required readings

409.description: Link is full or idempotency key conflicts

410.description: Link is disabled, expired, or requires an unsupported reading count

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Opaque key for safe request retries

409.description: Idempotency key reused with a different request
Submission limit is below the existing count

200.description: Paginated assessments for a center-owned link
Center-owned linked assessment and reading summary

503.description: PDF renderer is unavailable or busy; retry later

post.summary: Recalculates scoring from saved engine results, replacing the previous report.
post.description:
Only completed or failed submissions owned by the authenticated center with
successful saved results for every reading are eligible. Provider responses
and alignments are preserved; only findings, coverage, and the report are
rebuilt. This job never calls Azure and works without Azure credentials.

202.description: Rescoring queued from saved engine results; previous scoring report is no longer available

404.description: Assessment not found in this center

409.description: Assessment or job is unfinished, or saved reading evidence is incomplete

parameters.name: reading_index
parameters.description: Only this reading; omitted means all snapshot readings

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque next_cursor from the same assessment, reading filter, and uncertainty mode

parameters.name: include_uncertainties
parameters.description: Default false preserves error-only pagination. True adds separately labeled uncertain findings and full per-reading percentage-example coverage; errors and uncertainties share the page limit.

200.description: Persisted errors, optional uncertainty and coverage explanations from report-pinned evidence; no rescoring or raw provider evidence

400.description: Invalid reading, page size, or cursor

404.description: Assessment not found in this center

503.description: Authentication is not configured or temporarily unavailable

401.description: Refresh token is invalid or expired

200.description: Available passage versions with preview content and required readings for new links
Login shell for the server-side preview editor; rendering requires center login
Self-contained HTML preview; no persistence or Chromium process

400.description: Invalid report JSON or inconsistent mock results

500.description: Server report assets could not be loaded

audio_reference.description: Stored original recording before it is split into readings.

required_readings.description: Recording count fixed at creation, independent of later server configuration.

context.description: Reference sentence context from the immutable passage, never inferred audio text.

location.description: One-based reference positions, or explicitly labelled recognition-only positions.

observed.description: Null when the detector did not persist an observed realization.

scored_in_report.description: An error can exist even when other missing evidence left the item unscored.

AssessmentReport.description: Final assessment report and its creation time.

item_summaries.description: Full selected-reading coverage, independent of the current findings page.

non_perfect_items.description: All scored checks below Perfect, including incidence-based checks.

uncertainties.description: Populated only with include_uncertainties=true; shares the page limit/cursor with errors.

learner_reference.description: Learner identifier used by the center.

ExpectedProminence.description: Whether the expert annotation marks a word or realization as prominent.

IntonationSegmentRole.description: Ordered role of a series element or one side of an alternative question.

failure_message.description: Safe explanation for a failed processing job, when available.

password.description: Plaintext password sent only over HTTPS; only its Argon2id hash is stored.

NonPerfectScoredItem.description:
A scored check below Perfect in the saved report, independent of evidence
availability, reading filters, and findings pagination.

context.description: Optional learner-facing context for this passage version.
context.example: The passage describes a cousin adjusting to life in a new city.

reference_text.description: Full learner-facing passage text for center-side previews.

required_readings.description: Number of readings required when a link is created for this passage.

context.description: Optional learner-facing context stored with this passage version.
context.example: The passage describes a cousin adjusting to life in a new city.

dry_run.description: Validate and return the version and hash without writing to PostgreSQL.

passage_id.description: Stable application ID assigned to this passage.

PassageIntonation.description: An explicitly mapped intonation item and its word-level contour anchors.

PassageIntonationSegment.description: An inclusive word range within one intonation contour.

context.description: Optional learner-facing context associated with this immutable passage version.

title.description: Human-readable passage title from the Engine Passage source export.

PassagePhoneTarget.description: One explicitly mapped phoneme occurrence used by a direct assessment item.

PassageProvenance.description: Source and approval information retained for an imported passage.

PassageScoringExample.description: A named scoring opportunity that can contain multiple detector targets.

PassageScoringTarget.description: One approved detector target within a named scoring opportunity.

oneOf.description: Compiled Item 64 expectations from the approved Sentence Tags export.

PassageSpan.description: An explicitly approved word or phrase pronunciation annotation.

PassageSyllableTarget.description: One mapped unstressed syllable occurrence used by the reduction item.

expected_phone.description: Empty when the provider supplies the reading-specific reference phone.

PitchDirection.description: Approved direction of pitch movement over an intonation segment.

max_audio_seconds.description: Maximum duration of one complete recording containing all required readings.

ReportArea.description: An area-level band, pooled from its scored percentage checks.

oneOf.description: None means there were no scored percentage checks in this area.

ReportAreaKind.description: Stable presentation areas for the pronunciation report.

ReportContent.description: Versioned, provenance-bound report content with one row per rubric item.

areas.description: Absent on historical snapshots created before area aggregation.

ReportItem.description: One flat row for an item from MIN_SCORING_ITEM_ID through MAX_SCORING_ITEM_ID.

blocking_targets.description:
Uncertain targets and reasons, including those that lower a scored band.
Historical snapshots may omit these even when evidence was incomplete.

ReportPreviewRequest.description: Mock data only: nothing is read from or written to an assessment.

examples.description: Optional mock reference examples keyed by item ID; never treated as findings.

ReportTargetBlocker.description: A target-level reason included when report coverage is incomplete.

ResultItemEvidenceSummary.description:
Counts named scoring examples, not individual phones/targets. These describe
persisted findings and do not recompute or replace the saved band.

correct_examples.description: Examples counted as correct by the all-NO_ERROR aggregation policy.

uncertain_examples.description: Includes ambiguous, unassessable, unsupported, and missing target evidence.

uncertainty_affects_band.description: True only for scored v2 percentage checks with uncertain examples.

details_available.description: False on historical readings without persisted detector findings/coverage.

ResultUncertaintyOutcome.description: Uncertainty is distinct from a confirmed detector error.

ScoreBand.description: User-facing bands serialize as their human labels.

SentenceStressExpectation.description: One word or approved contraction span in the expert stress annotation.

prominent_syllable_ordinal.description: Present when capitalization identifies a stressed syllable within a hyphenated word.

prominent_word_id.description: Word receiving the prominence mark, including within approved contractions.

required_reductions.description: Populated only from an explicit approved Item 43 Word Tags annotation.

SentenceStressRealization.description: An allowed surface form for one reference word span.

SentenceStressReductionExpectation.description: Required weak-form pronunciation copied from an explicitly tagged Item 43 word.

SentenceStressReference.description: Expert-authored sentence stress reference, kept separate from detector calibration.

compiler_version.description: Version of the CSV annotation compiler, independent of scoring behavior.

reference_version.description: Expert reference date, independent of any detector calibration version.

source_annotation.description: Exact source cell, including explanatory notes.

spoken_annotation.description: Annotation text after removing parenthetical editorial notes.

unresolved_mappings.description: Explicitly unresolved mappings; compilation never guesses a word ID.
